text.card: A red giant 2,568 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 0.88 solar masses and 8.7 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,608 K at its surface.
